text:
Lina R.: Quick one — international candidate (Arjun P) arriving LAX tomorrow morning. He asked if we can provide a visa re-entry support letter and whether shuttle from SFO is possible.
Mateo S.: Shuttle from SFO not ideal; we usually reimburse flights or rideshares for international connecting flights. What's his arrival airport and ETA?
Lina R.: Landed LAX 07:10 local, connecting to SFO at 12:30. Recruiter asked if we can cover the short SFO->Palo Alto shuttle or offer rideshare. Candidate prefers to avoid public transit early morning.
Ellen (People Ops): Approve up to $80 rideshare for SFO->office if candidate presents receipt. If he prefers shuttle, we can prepay a SuperShuttle voucher. Which is easier?
Lina R.: I'll offer both and ask his preference. Also he mentioned limited English comfort for technical interview and requested a Spanish interpreter.
Mateo S.: Do we have interpreter budget? I think yes for accessibility — request through vendor ASAP.
Ellen (People Ops): Confirmed: we have vendor on contract. Booking Spanish interpreter for 3 hours (onsite + debrief) approved. I'll create the vendor request now and mark the meeting as "interpreted".
ops-bot: Calendar note updated: "Interpreter booked (Spanish)"; reminder set 1 day and 1 hour before.
Lina R.: He also asked about tax paperwork since he's a contractor in his country; recruiter raised question if we should send contractor paperwork packet ahead of time.
Ellen (People Ops): Send the standard "candidate contractor info" packet but include a note: "For informational purposes only; final hiring team will handle tax onboarding if hired." Don't request signatures pre-offer.
Mateo S.: For the onsite kit: candidate requested a chair with lumbar support and a quiet space for a 15-min mindfulness break between interviews.
facilities-bot: Standing desk and Ergo Chair reserved for room 3C; Quiet room reserved 9:50-10:10.
Lina R.: Thanks — please also reserve a non-peanut snack (she's allergic) and bottled water.
Ellen (People Ops): Noted. I'll message cafe and label the snack as "No nuts".
Lina R.: Access question: candidate needs campus badge for building. Do we have same-day badge printing?
Ellen (People Ops): Yes — front desk will issue visitor badge. Ask them to bring passport and the confirmation email. We'll pre-fill the form and leave a sticky note at reception.
Mateo S.: One last: coding exercise — candidate prefers Python 3.10 + Vim. We can provision a Linux VM and a USB keyboard with US layout.
Ellen (People Ops): VM image "candidate-sdk-2026" reserved and keyboard labelled. Lina, please paste SSH/VM details into calendar note.
Lina R.: Will do and I'll DM candidate about travel options, interpreter confirmation, expense instructions (email expenses@redwood.com with subject "Candidate Travel - Arjun P"), and badge pickup.
ops-bot: Confirmation message scheduled to send to candidate 2 hours after this thread.
Mateo S.: Great. If vendor questions, loop me in.
Ellen (People Ops): Thanks team. If candidate requests remote instead, keep interpreter for remote session as well.
Lina R.: Copy — closing loop. :white_check_mark:
